folded.id: sake|for|dis
folded.subject: sake
folded.object: dis

spans.text: Everi human being, naim dem born free and dem de equal for dignity and di rights wey we get, as human beings, God come give us beta sense wey we de take tink well, well and beta mind, sake for dis, we must to treat each other like broda and sister.

folded.id: sake|for|sake of im religion or di kontri wey e come from
folded.subject: sake
folded.object: sake of im religion or di kontri wey e come from

spans.text: Man or woman, so far e don reach di age wey e fit marry, so tay nobodi fit disturb am, sake for sake of im religion or di kontri wey e come from, get di right to marry and get im own family.

folded.id: sake|for|say
folded.subject: sake
folded.object: say

spans.text: Now therefore, dis meeting now come talk say dis universal declaration of human rights talk say naim be di achievement wey all di people and all di nations of di world achieve, sake for say, everi person and everi ting wey dey for our society must to know all di rights and make dem keep am for their mind everi time.
Everi one naim get right say make dem give am good judgement if dem bring di person before people wey go de judge am, sake for say e do someting wey e be say di right wey e be im own, e violate am.

Everione naim get right to go anoda kontri, wey e like to tell dem say im wan live for dat kontri, sake for say dem de look for am for im own kontri or dem won arrest am for im kontri, wen im no do any bad ting.

But if dat person really do bad ting o, for im own kontri and e come run comot to wan go live for anoda kontri, sake for say di goment of im kontri de look for am, di goment of di kontri wey e run go, no go gree at all, at all o.

folded.id: say|for|sake dem de oppress am or dem de treat am harshly
folded.subject: say
folded.object: sake dem de oppress am or dem de treat am harshly

spans.text: Since e de important say if man no go by force fight well, well, say for sake dem de oppress am or dem de treat am harshly, then de law of di society must to protect di human rights wey human beings get, e de important say make all di kontris for dis world make sure say dem be friends.

folded.id: travel comot|for|where e de live to anoda place
folded.subject: travel comot
folded.object: where e de live to anoda place

spans.text: Everione naim get right to go anywhere wey e wan go, weda na to go see im friend o, or to go anoda town o, or to travel comot for where e de live to anoda place.

folded.id: we all|come|be like one family
folded.subject: we all
folded.object: be like one family

spans.text: Dem recognise say human beings get dignity wey dey with us and rights wey go make all of us friendly with each other, so tay, we all come be like one family.

folded.id: weda|for|di law of im kontri or for di whole world
folded.subject: weda
folded.object: di law of im kontri or for di whole world

spans.text: Dem come talk again say nobodi fit talk say person do bad ting if di ting no really bad, weda for di law of im kontri or for di whole world, for dat time wen e do am.

folded.id: wey de|for|di whole world
folded.subject: wey de
folded.object: di whole world

spans.text: Na dis be di foundation of our freedom and peace wey de for di whole world.

folded.id: wey dey|for|dis small book
folded.subject: wey dey
folded.object: dis small book

spans.text: Everi one naim de entitle to all di rights and freedom wey dey for dis small book, no mata di kind language wey person dey speak, di kontri wey one come from, di kind religion wey one de do, di kind ting wey one dey tink, di kind person wey one be, di how dem take born one, di kind place wey one come from, di kind propati wey one get or weda you be man or woman.
